scope: Corollary 1.4 (Determinantal processes on countable groups) of the manuscript “The free uniform spanning forest is a factor of IID” (preprints/The-free-uniform-spanning-forest-is-a-factor-of-IID-September-25-2026/The-free-uniform-spanning-forest-is-a-factor-of-IID-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 231 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 478f5137621e0b3b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Γ be a countable group and let K be a self-adjoint positive contraction on ℓ2(Γ), so 0 ≤ K ≤ I. If the determinantal probability law with kernel K is invariant under the regular left action, then it is a factor of IID under that action. In particular, this holds whenever K commutes with the left regular representation of Γ.
